segments.name: QxH
segments.description: Live video retail of consumer products through QVC and HSN television channels, websites and digital platforms for U.S. customers.
segments.evidence: QxH's televised shopping programs, including live and recorded content, are broadcast across multiple channels nationally on a full time basis, including the main QVC and HSN channels as well as the additional channels of QVC2, QVC3 and HSN2.

segments.name: QVC-International
segments.description: Live video retail for customers outside the U.S., mainly in Japan, Germany, the U.K. and Italy, across broadcast, web and apps.
segments.evidence: QVC has two reportable segments: QxH and QVC-International.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay QVC for consumer products such as home, apparel, beauty and jewelry bought through televised programs, websites and mobile apps.
revenueModel.evidence: is a retailer of a wide range of consumer products, which are marketed and sold primarily by merchandise-focused televised shopping programs, the internet and mobile applications.
